_comment: SUBMISSION GUIDELINES PAGE COPY (English). PLACEHOLDER CONTENT + AN INTERPRETATION CALL: the original Phase 2 plan listed 'Structured Submissions' as a page; the existing Submissions page (submissions.njk) already covers 'where to upload' (links to the real Google Forms), and Rules & Resources already covers detailed judging/submission rules (deadline, required files) in real, non-placeholder content. To avoid duplicating either, this page was built as a short checklist-style page — 'what to prepare before you submit' — that LINKS to both rather than repeating their content. If this isn't what 'Structured Submissions' was supposed to mean, this whole page's approach (not just its placeholder text) may need to change once real requirements are clear, not just its wording.
